title: Bass players Vic Gaspar, Albert Glenny and Buddy Johnson
summary: Williams recalls which bands bass players such as Glenny and Johnson played in.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Bass players: lineage, tone and technique

blocks.x: I wasn't sure it was. Imperial band. Buddy Johnson. I don't know which band. He played one of them dance bands too.

Before he'd come on the roof cart with us. You know. Jimmy. Jimmy. Huh? The bass player you're talking about. No, Buddy Johnson. Yank's brother. He was on the roof cart. He was on the roof cart. Yeah. Yeah. That was swell. That was swell.
That was swell. That was swell. That was swell. That was swell. That was swell.
Yeah, but I mean before that he played in some of them bands way back. Yeah, he played in one of them bands. Yeah, he played in one of them bands, but I don't know because I was a kid.
And Glenny, who did you play with him with?

Albert Glenny, I played with Albert Glenny with, who did I play with him with? I believe he played with Buddy a while. Something happened to Simon or something. And he played with a Suiv, not too long.

Vic, I played with Vic. Who was I with when I played with Vic? I believe Manuel Key come up on the roof corner and played with a Suiv. Jimmy Johnson stayed sick for about six months. And he'd be okay, okay, come up and play with us.
